artifacts.role: Reference implementation for duplex audio streaming, hybrid role/voice prompting and offline evaluation

license.rationale: The exact repository code revision is MIT. This does not approve the separately licensed model weights or the upstream server architecture for production.

notes: Reference patterns may be reimplemented behind Clicko contracts; the upstream server is not tenant-safe by construction.
The upstream server serializes sessions, auto-downloads artifacts, logs prompts and loads .pt voice embeddings with torch.load.

artifacts.role: English full-duplex speech-to-speech model with voice and role conditioning

license.declared_license: NVIDIA Open Model License Agreement (custom; Hugging Face license: other)
license.rationale: Commercial use is stated, but the custom model agreement is not an OSI open-source license and acceptance is gated. It conflicts with the current Clicko open-source-only policy.

notes: No model bytes or voice pack were downloaded and no license was accepted on the user's behalf.
The published model is English input/output only and lists A100/H100 Linux support; it is not a PT-BR ad-voice candidate.
Rejected means no provider, image, benchmark with human voice, deployment or automatic model download.
The research value is retained in the duplex session protocol, interruption metrics and hybrid prompt separation.
